profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer - Cloudy with a DevSecOps Addiction
profile.summary: Proven Engineer with two decades of experience designing, building and operating Cloud computing platforms. Strong eye for elegant solutions to complex business requirements. Driven and motivated team player with excellent technical leadership abilities. Skills include Kubernetes, Docker, Ansible, Terraform, Jenkins, Go, Python, GCP, Azure and AWS.

positions.title: Senior Platform Engineer
positions.description:
* Responsible for modernizing and evolving DevOps practices and infrastructure tools
* Designed and built Kubernetes infrastructure platform for event driven micro service application
positions.insights: Skills: Jenkins · Kubernetes · Capacity Planning · Windows Server · Terraform · Pulumi · Linux · Cloud Computing · GitOps · Microsoft Azure · Go · IT Strategy · CI/CD · DNS · Load Balancing · Technical Architecture · Containerization · DevOps · Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Microservices

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
* Enabled software developers across the enterprise to streamline their development and deployment workflows through the creation of AWS-based serverless technologies like Fargate and CodeBuild/CodePipeline
* Created automation tools used to streamline delivery of new AWS account, logging configurations, and platform services
* Worked with junior developers and engineers to help in the understanding of enterprise architecture, AWS products, and corporate processes
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Capacity Planning · Terraform · Linux · Cloud Computing · Microsoft Azure · Go · IT Strategy · CI/CD · DNS · Load Balancing · Technical Architecture · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Containerization · DevOps · Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Microservices

positions.title: Sr. Systems Engineer
positions.description:
* Worked as Solutions Architect to gather requirements, implement, and support cloud-first solutions for enterprise customers
* Designed customer management workflow driving down customer provisioning times and eliminating human error
positions.insights: Skills: Jenkins · Capacity Planning · Linux · Cloud Computing · CI/CD · DNS · Load Balancing · Containerization · DevOps · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Devops Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed and created HITRUST compliant platform for micro service applications in AWS based on Docker Swarm
* Prioritized and developed end to end CICD process for infrastructure and applications based on Jenkins Pipelines and DSL with multiple levels of approval for content/code promotion
* Spearheaded exploratory effort to evaluate LinuxKit and other edge technology for usability in future products
* Designed HITRUST compliant VPN/AWS VPC access and authentication system based on StrongSwan and OpenLDAP with 2 factor authentication
positions.insights: Skills: Ansible · Capacity Planning · Terraform · Linux · Cloud Computing · IT Strategy · CI/CD · DNS · Load Balancing · Technical Architecture · Containerization · DevOps · Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Microservices

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed and built automated deployment system for ASP.NET applications using Ansible and Jenkins
* Conceptualized and created automated CICD processes for multi-platform infrastructure and applications using Jenkins Job DSL
* Implemented production HA MongoDB Replica Set infrastructure and deployment process based on Docker
positions.insights: Skills: Jenkins · Ansible · Capacity Planning · Terraform · Linux · Cloud Computing · CI/CD · DNS · Load Balancing · Technical Architecture · Containerization · DevOps · Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Microservices

positions.title: Sr. Cloud Engineer
positions.description:
* Assisted with planning and implementation of HIPAA and HITRUST certified cloud application platform for healthcare developers based on Docker and Ubuntu
* Created multipurpose software VPN appliance for use by healthcare customers
* Automated core software and configuration lifecycle using Docker registry and Jenkins
* Designed hosting platform for exchange of HL7 messages between health systems
positions.insights: Skills: Jenkins · Capacity Planning · Windows Server · Terraform · Linux · Cloud Computing · CI/CD · DNS · Load Balancing · Technical Architecture · Containerization · DevOps · Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Sr. System Engineer
positions.description:
* Spearheaded the design and implementation of infrastructure for the Cloud Load Balancer product using Debian and 3rd party load balancing technologies
* Designed and maintained several key automation components integral to the operation of the Cloud Sites platform using Ruby
* Implemented and improved infrastructure that supported the Cloud Databases product based on OpenStack
* Overhauled email hosting platform leveraging commodity hardware and diskless boot techniques similar to today’s Cloud operational paradigms 
* Headed deployment and design of enterprise web application hosting platform and later evolved it into the modern day Cloud Sites product
positions.insights: Skills: Jenkins · Capacity Planning · Windows Server · Linux · Cloud Computing · CI/CD · DNS · Load Balancing · Technical Architecture · Containerization · DevOps · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed and implemented new application change management system and migrated users from legacy systems
* Responsible for maintenance of legacy and new Microsoft Windows Server systems
* Responsible for implementation and maintenance of new hosting environment and requisite migration of applications and users from legacy environment
positions.insights: Skills: Capacity Planning · Windows Server · DNS · Load Balancing · Technical Architecture

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
* Operated network and computing infrastructure for cooperative’s Internet service provider based on Windows NT, FreeBSD and Linux
* Designed rural wireless broadband system for end users that utilized a combination of open source software and hardware from Lucent

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
* Setup and maintained SGI IRIX, Sun Solaris and Linux servers in support of organization’s community outreach and Internet services
* Supported wired and wireless LAN and WAN connections that delivered Internet access to remote rural communities
